scope: 40 official facet definitions plus six bundled vendor extensions, eight pinned DataHub targets; source projections and bounded live evidence only
method: Converter and controller source traces at immutable target heads; no PR head execution. Positive source mappings are not proof of persistence/readback.
attachment_correction: The initial inventory draft overlisted dataQualityAssertions; pinned facet definition allOf references InputDatasetFacet, and the corrected inventory now lists only inputFacets.

rechecked_19800_none_candidates.finding: No outputFacets.subset reader or generic output observation retention in the converter.
No inputFacets.subset reader or generic input observation retention in the converter.
No DatasetFacets.catalog reader or generic dataset facet retention.
No inputFacets.dataQualityAssertions reader or native assertion projection.
The only getDataQualityMetrics() call reads dataset.getFacets(), not inputFacets.
No DatasetFacets.dataSource reader; dataset name and namespace identity do not project this facet.
No RunFacets.environmentVariables reader or generic run facet retention.
FALSE NEGATIVE: #18175 and later read RunFacets.errorMessage into DPI errorMessage, programmingLanguage, and capped stackTrace custom properties.
No RunFacets.executionParameters reader or generic run facet retention.
No DatasetFacets.hierarchy reader or native container mapping.
No inputFacets.inputStatistics reader or input operation mapping.
No RunFacets.jobDependencies reader or native job dependency edges.
No OpenLineage DatasetFacets.lineage reader; DatahubJob.getLineage() refers to an already mapped DataHub dataset.
No OpenLineage JobFacets.lineage reader or native explicit lineage edges.
No JobFacets.sourceCode reader; sourceCodeLocation is a separate facet.
The getTags() calls read JobFacets and DatasetFacets, not RunFacets.tags.
No RunFacets.test reader or native test assertion mapping.
